snippet.title: RIFTFALL Gameplay - Boss Fights
snippet.description:
Try RIFTFALL Demo on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4965490/RIFTFALL/

RIFTFALL is a fast, brutal retro FPS inspired by DOOM, Quake, Unreal Tournament, and Duke Nukem 3D, rebuilt with modern speed, massive bosses, and zero modern nonsense.

Fight through a 20-level campaign across six different biomes, unlock red, blue, and yellow skull keys, discover hidden secrets, and survive 20 handcrafted boss arenas where simply shooting harder is not enough.

Destroy crystal towers to weaken an ice giant, drop an immortal lava colossus into molten fire, hack terminals while fighting a giant cyber brain, climb a walking titan, battle across a moving train, fire castle catapults at a dragon, and face the final RIFTFALL DEVOURER.

RIFTFALL features six heavy weapons with devastating alternate attacks, 30+ enemy types, destructible environments, procedural level layouts, Rage Mode, bullet time, combat dashing, permanent upgrades, Steam achievements, global leaderboards, and four AI marine squadmates with over 500 voiced lines.
